articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and agentic tool use, narrowing the gap between LLM-based assistants and autonomous software engineers.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Graduate-Level Scientific Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which surpasses previous frontier models on GPQA Diamond, MathOdyssey, and a new molecular biology reasoning benchmark. The model leverages a mixture-of-experts architecture with over 2 trillion parameters and integrates retrieval-augmented generation natively, enabling verifiable citation of scientific literature during inference.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen-3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in select Gigafactory assembly operations, handling tasks such as parts sorting, quality visual inspection, and light component installation. The Gen-3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without cloud connectivity.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction Site Logistics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform tailored for construction environments, capable of autonomously navigating unstructured terrain, carrying payloads up to 50 kg, and coordinating with Spot units for site mapping. The system uses a hierarchical reinforcement learning stack trained in high-fidelity simulation and transferred to hardware with minimal fine-tuning.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Auditing Framework as Open Standard
articles.summary: Anthropic published an open specification for its Constitutional AI auditing framework, enabling third-party organizations to systematically evaluate LLM alignment properties including refusal calibration, bias profiles, and instruction hierarchy adherence. Several major enterprises and two government agencies have committed to piloting the framework, marking a significant step toward standardized AI safety evaluation.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Transistor Chips
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, delivering a 25% power efficiency gain and 15% performance improvement over its 2nm node. Early customers include Apple and NVIDIA, with the node expected to power next-generation AI accelerators and mobile SoCs shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Hits 1,000-Cycle Milestone in EV Road Tests
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its solid-state lithium-metal cells have exceeded 1,000 full charge-discharge cycles in real-world EV testing with a major automotive OEM while retaining over 90% capacity. The achievement addresses the primary durability concern that has historically blocked solid-state battery commercialization and puts the company on track for series production in late 2027.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production and Foundation Model Training
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation, with funding earmarked for scaling manufacturing of its Figure 02 humanoid and training proprietary vision-language-action foundation models on millions of hours of manipulation data. The company plans to expand pilot deployments beyond BMW to logistics and healthcare verticals by mid-2027.
